blockers:
claim: In-flight frame counter removed without replacement: the old code tracked queued-but-not-yet-processed frames via m_inFlightFrames to provide backpressure at the queuing point. This counter is now gone and the new mechanism doesn't prevent queue buildup.; file: app/qttunebridge.h; quote: int m_guiNotifyCount = 0;           // incremented per frame notification
+    // QAtomicInteger<int> m_notifyRateCounter{0};  // for rate calc (optional, per-second)
questions: What is the intended backpressure strategy now that m_inFlightFrames is removed? The new check uses m_currentFrameCount which is incremented in handleFrameInternal (GUI thread), creating a race condition where many frames can be queued before the limit is hit.
The removed test StreamingContinuesPastTenThousandFrames explicitly tested the in-flight gate behavior. How should the new design ensure the stream doesn't freeze when the model hits capacity?
nits: Minor style improvement in onFrame null check
Removed unused SignalListModel class and associated tests reduce code coverage
